Champaklal proudly informs Gokuldham members that his childhood village friends visited, and he has pledged a ₹25 lakh donation to build a girls' school in their village in memory of Jethalal's mother ("Kanchanba Kanyashala"). The society members praise Bapuji and Jethalal for their generosity.
